Name: Ariel the golden retriever (Mount)
Author: NightshadowCat93
Description:
Mod dedicated to my friend's sweet dog Ariel, now you can ride her across the country!

To use this mod, just download the zipped file, unzip it, take the png file you want to use, go to the "assets" folder of the Adopt and Skin mod, then go to "skins" and create a folder there named "Horse" and just drop or copy/paste your skin there and rename it "Horse_1" to replace your horse's skin with this skin.

Should work with other mods but not tested yet.
